findings.title: Helper returns the smaller value
findings.description: `larger` in `src/extra.rs` returns `b` when `a > b` and `a` otherwise, so it selects the smaller of the two arguments. Any caller that relies on it to get the maximum will silently compute the wrong value for every input where the arguments differ.
